**Job Description

**_Are you ready to play a key role in transforming resource allocation at one of the leading financial institutions? Join our Enterprise Cost Steering team to lead initiatives that improve financial health through strategic cost optimization. This position offers a unique opportunity to influence cost efficiency strategies Group-wide.

_**What You Will Be Doing

**As an Experienced Consultant in Enterprise Cost Steering, you will support the executive leadership team with insights and recommendations to optimize cost structures. Working closely with Finance teams, Procurement, Support functions, and Business Units, you will identify cost-optimizing opportunities and implement best practices that strengthen our financial foundation.

• Own, drive, coordinate and execute end-to-end cost efficiency initiatives across the Group, including planning, tracking progress and managing delivery against agreed milestones

• Apply strong critical thinking by questioning assumptions and provide well-reasoned recommendations

• Leverage data analytics to conduct comprehensive cost analysis and identify cost efficiency opportunities

• Collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to design and implement cost steering frameworks, ensuring clear governance, roles and responsibilities

• Translate complex data into actionable insights for senior leadership

• Act as trusted partner providing expert guidance on strategic cost initiatives

• Build and maintain dashboards and tools to support ongoing cost analysis, generating actionable insights, reporting and decision-making

• Facilitate workshops to align stakeholders and build consensus on initiatives and drive agreed actions to completion

**About You

**

• Strong consulting and project management background, with experience delivering strategic solutions in complex organisations

• Solid experience in enterprise-level cost steering or strategic cost management

• Excellent problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail

• Proven ability to independently manage initiatives from ideation through execution, including defining scope, plans, milestones, dependencies and delivery risks

• Strong critical thinking skills with ability to challenge assumptions

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to engage, influence and build trust across all levels while maintaining alignment, accountability and momentum

• Advanced skills in data analysis, reporting and visualisation tools

• Master's degree in finance, economics, business administration or similar

You thrive in dynamic environments with evolving priorities and demonstrate collaborative teamwork alongside quantitative expertise to support strategic decision-making.

**What We Offer You

**You will join a supportive team that values collaboration and professional growth. We offer hybrid working with 3 to 4 days per week in the office to promote knowledge sharing and culture building. You will have opportunities to develop your expertise while making meaningful contributions to our financial health and cost efficiency initiatives.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**We would love to hear from you if this opportunity excites you. Please reach out to Hadis Atighi at kho@danskebank.dk for any questions about the role. We process applications continuously, so we encourage you to apply sooner rather than later.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.description:
Department of Mathematical Sciences, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen

   

  Department of Mathematical Sciences (MATH) invites applicants for PhD stipends in mathematics.

  The start date is ordinarily September 1, 2027, but can be subject to negotiation.

  There will be PhD stipends available in:

   	
• Algebraic and Arithmetic Geometry, Applied algebra, Combinatorics, Geometric group theory, Geometry and Geometric Analysis, Number Theory, Representation Theory, and Topology as covered by the section Algebra & Geometry and  Copenhagen Center for Geometry & Topology (GeoTop).    	
• Classical Analysis, Descriptive Set Theory, Functional Analysis, Geometric group theory, Harmonic Analysis, History of Mathematics, Mathematical Physics, Operator Algebras, Partial Differential Equations, Quantum Information, Quantum Computation and Quantum Simulation as covered by the section Analysis and Quantum, the Centre for the Mathematics of Quantum Theory  and the Quantum for Life Center.   You are welcome to contact any member of the department to discuss research projects.

   

  Who are we looking for?

  We are looking for candidates within the field of Mathematics or nearby fields, whose background and research interests are a strong fit with the areas of mathematics above.

  About the department

  The department has about 50 permanent scientific staff members; around 60 PhD students and 35 postdocs. It has strong research groups in many areas of mathematics, and active PhD, postdoc, and visitors’ programs. Our buildings are located in central Copenhagen next to the central park Fælledparken. Our website http://www.math.ku.dk/english provides more information about the department and the research  conducted at the department https://www.math.ku.dk/english/research/.  We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in a dynamic and international research environment.

  You can find more information about the PhD program on the homepage http://www.math.ku.dk/english/programmes/ph.d/. 

   

  The PhD programme 

  Depending on your level of education, you can undertake the PhD programme as either:

  Option A: A three year full-time study within the framework of the regular PhD programme (5+3 scheme), if you already have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree.

  Option B: An up to five year full-time study programme within the framework of the integrated MSc and PhD programme (the 3+5 scheme), if you do not have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree – but you have an education equivalent to a Danish bachelor’s degree.

  ********************************************************************************

  Option A: Getting into a position on the regular PhD programme 

  Qualifications needed for the regular programme
 To be eligible for the regular PhD programme, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. mathematics or closely related. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.

  Terms of employment in the regular programme 
 Employment as PhD fellow is full time and for maximum 3 years.

  Employment is conditional upon your successful enrolment as a PhD student at the PhD School at the Faculty of Science, University of Copenhagen. This requires submission and acceptance of an application for the specific project formulated by the applicant.

  Terms of appointment and payment according to the agreement between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

  Option B: Getting into a position on the integrated MSc and PhD programme

  Qualifications needed for the integrated MSc and PhD programme 

  If you do not have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish master’s degree, you might be qualified for the integrated MSc and PhD programme, if you have an education equivalent to a relevant Danish bachelor’s degree. Here you can find out, if that is relevant for you: General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.  

  Terms of the integrated programme
 To be eligible for the integrated scholarship, you are (or are eligible to be) enrolled in one of the faculty’s master’s programmes in Mathematics or Quantum Information Science.

  Students on the integrated programme will enroll as PhD students simultaneously with completing their enrollment in this MSc degree programme.

  The duration of the integrated programme is up to five years, and depends on the amount of credits that you have passed on your MSc programme. For further information about the study programme, please see: www.science.ku.dk/phd, “Study Structures”.

  Until the MSc degree is obtained, (when exactly two years of the full 3+5 programme remains), the grant will be paid partly in the form of up to 48 state education grant portions (in Danish: “SU-klip”) plus salary for work (teaching, supervision etc.) totalling a workload of 150 working hours per year. A PhD grant portion is currently (2026) DKK 7.426 before tax.
 
 When you have obtained the MSc degree, you will transfer to the salary-earning part of the scholarship for a period of two years. At that point, the terms of employment and payment will be according to the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State (AC). The position is covered by the Protocol on Job Structure.

   

  Responsibilities and tasks in both PhD programmes

   	
• Complete and pass the MSc education in accordance with the curriculum of the MSc programme  (ONLY when you are attending the integrated MSc and PhD programme) 	
• Carry through an independent research project under supervision 	
• Complete PhD courses corresponding to approx. 30 ECTS / ½ FTE 	
• Participate in active research environments, including a stay at another research institution, preferably abroad 	
• Teaching and knowledge dissemination activities 	
• Write scientific papers aimed at high-impact journals 	
• Write and defend a PhD thesis on the basis of your project   We are looking for the following qualifications and experience:

   	
• Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project 	
• Relevant work experience 	
• Other relevant professional experience, including publications (if any) 	
• A curious mind-set with a strong interest in Mathematics 	
• Good English skills    

  Application and Assessment Procedure

  Your application including all attachments must be in English and submitted electronically by clicking APPLY NOW below.

  Please include: 

   	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page) 	
• Curriculum vitae including information about your education, experience, publications (if any), language skills and other skills relevant for the position 	
• Original diplomas for Bachelor’s or Master’s and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorized English translation if issued in another language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. 	
• Reference letters (if available; letters can be uploaded as part of the application or sent to hr-math@adm.ku.dk by the reference person).   When you will be affiliated with the University of Copenhagen or otherwise have access to their research, you may be required to undergo a background screening. The purpose is to protect the security and research integrity of the University of Copenhagen.

   

  Application deadline: 

  The deadline for applications is 15 November 2026, 23:59 GMT+1. 

  We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After deadline, a number of applicants will be selected for academic assessment (shortlisted) by a committee of unbiased experts. You are notified whether you will be passed for assessment.

  An assessment committee will assess the qualifications and experience of the shortlisted applicants with respect to the research area, skills and other requirements. The assessors will conclude whether each applicant is qualified. The assessed applicants will have the opportunity to comment on their assessment. You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/.

  Questions
 For specific information about the PhD fellowship, please contact the principal supervisor.

  General information about PhD study at the Faculty of SCIENCE is available at the PhD School’s website: https://www.science.ku.dk/phd/.

  The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the surrounding community and invites all regardless of personal background to apply for the position.

jobs.occupation: Join Nykredit Markets as a Quantitative Developer (Analyst/Associate)
jobs.description:
_Would you like to help develop the next generation of quantitative models, tools, and AI solutions in Nykredit Markets? Do you thrive at the intersection of financial markets, technology, and innovation, and are you motivated by turning complex challenges into concrete solutions? Then this could be the opportunity for you.

_A key part of Nykredit Markets’ new strategy is a comprehensive upgrade of our quant platform and models. In Quantitative Solutions, we are responsible for this initiative and are currently developing Dragonfly — a modern, scalable, and highly optimized quant platform used for market making, pricing, and risk management of financial instruments across asset classes.

We are therefore looking for a Quantitative Developer who wants to work closely with the business and help develop and maintain solutions used daily by traders, sales professionals, and other specialists in Nykredit Markets.

**Your primary responsibilities:

**

• Design and development of analytics applications: Design, develop, and maintain Dragonfly applications and tools for pricing, risk management, and modeling of financial markets and instruments.

• Building scalable and robust quant infrastructure: Ensure that our quant platform and models run reliably and scale effectively, from infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines to monitoring and operations.

• Monitoring and optimizing production flows: Ensure robust processes, high data quality, and stable operation of our models and quant platform.

• Staying ahead with AI and new technology: Identify relevant AI use cases and help turn them into business solutions that create value in Markets and for our clients.

• Quantitative analysis and technical problem-solving: Work on complex financial and technological challenges and translate technical or quantitative analyses into concrete improvements and new opportunities.

**Are you the one we are looking for?

**We welcome applications from recent graduates, final-year Master’s students, and candidates with up to three years of relevant work experience. Depending on your qualifications and experience, the role will be at Analyst or Associate level.

We expect that you:

• hold a relevant university degree in finance, economics, IT, natural sciences, or engineering, with strong academic results,

• have strong software development and programming skills, including experience with Python and modern application development,

• have an interest in, and preferably experience with, AI or machine learning,

• are familiar with generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, or modern AI tools,

• understand software architecture, data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems,

• are analytically strong and motivated by solving complex financial and technical challenges,

• communicate effectively and collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders,

• have an interest in financial markets and quantitative analysis.

Experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure AI Foundry, cloud-native technologies, MLOps, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Django, React, or web development is an advantage, but not a requirement.

**Your new team

**You will join the QS Financial Engineering team, one of three teams in Quantitative Solutions. We are a department with a high level of professional expertise, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous development are central to our day-to-day work. The department consists of desk quants, quant developers, and financial engineers. Together, we ensure that Nykredit Markets has the right models, applications, and analytical decision-support capabilities to remain in the strongest possible position in the market.

**About Nykredit Markets

**Nykredit Markets is part of the Nykredit Group, one of Denmark’s largest financial institutions. Nykredit Markets offers a broad range of financial services and products within capital markets, including trading in bonds, credit, FX, and equities. We serve both institutional and private investors with advisory services and tailored investment solutions.

**Want to know more?

**You are welcome to contactme, Sabina Mandsberg, Head of QS Financial Engineering, at quant@nykredit.dk if you have any questions about the position.

If you have questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

_We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis and review applications as we receive them.

_We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

jobs.description:
**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**We are looking for several Lead Business Consultants to join our EMEA Consulting Services team, working with our clients across the UK and the Nordics. Our client base in the region is growing, and so is the breadth of expertise our implementation projects require. Rather than hiring for one narrow profile, we are opening multiple positions for implementation specialists across the full front-to-back platform, and we will match you to the projects where your depth is strongest.

The team allows for consulting excellency, efficiency in configuration and standardization as well as knowledge sharing and collaboration across divisions and market units. As a Lead Business Consultant you are, or will become, a trusted business and technology advisor for our clients in one or more of the following areas:

• Investment accounting and financial reporting (ABOR)

• Investment book of record (IBOR), position keeping and valuation

• Investment operations, settlement and post-trade processing

• Data management, interfaces and communications (Data & Com)

• Front office: portfolio management, trading and order management

• Compliance, regulatory and internal restrictions

• Performance measurement and attribution

• Risk management (market and liquidity)

• Alternative investments and private markets

• Instrument valuation and analytics (theoretical pricing)

You will be exposed to the complete spectrum of financial instruments and their valuation, from plain vanilla equity and fixed income instruments to complex OTC derivatives and private market assets. Furthermore, you will work with all processes related to your area of specialization.

As part of your induction you will be ‘hands-on’ in our software system and attend the three-weeks’ SimCorp Dimension® Academy.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**As a Lead Business Consultant you will take over a range of tasks in a project team, such as:

• Be responsible for major parts of SimCorp implementation projects in your area of specialisation: you anticipate client needs based on your understanding of the relevant business processes at asset managers, asset owners, insurers or banks and act as a trusted advisor to the client

• Design and configure solutions across multiple modules and project streams that enable our clients to reach their desired outcomes

• Connect your specialism to the wider front-to-back solution, working closely with colleagues who cover the adjacent areas of the platform

• Advise on and improve standard implementation processes as well as product and service offerings

• Identify opportunities for growth and explore new ideas, feeding this back to the organisation and supporting its development

• Participate in sales processes when required to position SimCorp concepts and offerings

• Instruct and mentor less experienced colleagues on the job and share knowledge with colleagues on an international level

**What We Value

**You like to deep dive into business processes in investment management and enjoy modelling them in our software. You have in-depth knowledge about the business at asset managers, fund managers, insurers or banks. In addition you bring with you:

• Degree in economics, finance, mathematics, computer science or similar qualification

• Previous experience as an Analyst or (Implementation) Consultant for asset managers, asset owners, banks or consulting firms

• FRM, CFA, CIPM or other relevant certifications/designations are desirable

• Team spirit and a desire to share your knowledge

• High communication and consulting skills

• High degree of commercial awareness, customer orientation and quality consciousness

• Fluency in English

• Readiness to travel

**Benefits

**SimCorp provides a range of benefits that may influence decisions regarding job offers. With operations in more than 30 offices globally, the benefits package can differ depending on the country. SimCorp implements a global hybrid work policy, requiring employees to be in the office two days per week and permitting remote work on other days. Additional information about location-specific benefits is available from the recruiter.

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually.

**Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed.

**At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact our Lead Talent Acquisition Partner, Azeta GUITI. If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp and you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above, but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway.

SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become a prominent provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 4,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide high-quality solutions to our clients

jobs.description:
**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The AP Manager leads the Accounts Payable team and is responsible for ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely processing of supplier invoices and payments globally, safeguarding financial integrity and operational efficiency. The role ensures high-quality Accounts Payable execution across the team, oversees month-end and audit processes, and acts as the escalation point for suppliers and internal stakeholders. As part of Shared Services, reporting to the Head of P2P, this position leads a team of 7 FTEs across multiple entities and is accountable for financial governance, KPI performance, and driving the function's transition from manual to automated, scalable processes. The role is a full-time position and reports to the Head of Procure to Pay.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Lead, coach and develop a team of 7 FTEs across the Accounts Payable function.

• Approve journals and oversee approval of new vendors and vendor changes.

• Own the monthly close process for Accounts Payable, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.

• Manage and delegate audit deliverables across quarterly, interim, and yearly cycles.

• Maintain control and oversight of the supplier invoice workflow, including monitoring and clearing backlog to keep processing on track.

• Own KPI reporting and performance tracking, providing visibility to the Head of P2P and key stakeholders.

• Drive continuous improvement, leading automation and process projects to move the function towards scalable, less manual ways of working.

• Ensure adherence to company policies, financial controls, and regulatory requirements, maintaining strong governance within the AP function.

**KEY EXPECTATIONS

**In this role, you take full ownership of your team's output and workload distribution, manage complex operational and people challenges, and drive process improvement across the function. jobs.occupation: Data & Automation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Us

**You know that rental bike you unlocked with your phone this morning? Or the tracker on your dog's collar that tells you he's two streets away, again? Neither of those works without a network connection. Onomondo is the layer that makes sure the data actually gets through.

We're the infrastructure behind the Internet of Things (IoT). Companies building connected products come to us for the connectivity that keeps their devices online, anywhere in the world, and for the platform where they manage, monitor, and troubleshoot it themselves.

****Where we sit

****We're somewhere between SaaS and telecom. We sell software, so we move fast, ship often, and care about the user experience. But we also operate inside telecommunications: which is more complex and technical than most software. Our customers are engineers, they ask hard questions and the relationship starts rather than ends at purchase.

That mix also makes us sticky. Most SaaS tools are nice to have. If our connectivity stops, our customers' products stop. That means our business grows as our customers and the industry grows. We've been growing fast and we don't plan to slow down, which is exactly why we need this role.

****What the role is

****We're looking for a Data & Automation Specialist who loves digging into data, and wants to use that foundation to make every team at Onomondo work smarter.

Your starting point is data. You'll work with complex, messy, multi-source data, from billing and revenue to product usage and commercial pipelines and turn it into analysis, dashboards and answers the business can act on. You'll partner with teams across the company (Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Operations) to understand what they need to know, and build the reporting that gets them there.

From that foundation, you'll look for where the data shows us time being lost, and fix it. That might be a script, an integration, a scheduled job, or an AI skill where that is the right approach. Getting there often means untangling messy data or a half-broken process first and you don't shy away from that groundwork when it's what the job actually needs.

AI is a real and growing part of the toolkit here. As you settle in, there's plenty of room to grow into that area. This includes our AI infrastructure and production agent stack, ready to be taken to the next level. Our vision is a backbone data warehouse with all data sources available so that our colleagues can self-service with trust through AI.

You'll report to our Data Analytics Manager, Jonathan, and be part of the Insights team.

****What you'll do

• Working with complex data across billing, revenue, product usage and commercial systems. Cleaning, modelling and making sense of it

• Building dashboards and visualizations that teams actually use to make decisions. We currently use Tableau for most of our complex visualizations, but we foresee leaning into an in-house setup. Groundwork is already in place to allow for broader adoptions and flexibility

• Running deeper analyses on the questions that matter, from revenue and billing trends to customer behavior and operational efficiency

• Finding the manual, repetitive workflows that cost the company the most time, and automating them in whatever form actually fits

• Building and maintaining integrations between the tools teams already use (Slack, Notion, HubSpot, Google Workspace, and others)

• Authoring and iterating AI skills where they're the right tool, using Onomondo's existing skill framework

• Growing into deeper AI/agent infrastructure work over time. Connectors, permissioning, production agents and moreNot all at once, of course. We'll start with what matters most, build it to scale, then keep going.

****What we're looking for

• Strong with data: comfortable with SQL, working in a data warehouse (we use BigQuery), and handling complex, imperfect datasets

• Experienced in data visualization and analysis. You can turn a messy question into a clear chart and a clear answer

• Comfortable writing code (Python or similar) to analyse, transform and automate

• A fixer by instinct. You notice friction and want to remove it, without needing to be asked

• Curious about AI, LLMs and agents, and keen to explore how they can make data and processes work better - even if that's not your primary experience yet

• Comfortable navigating ambiguity: nobody will hand you a fully-scoped ticket, you'll often have to find the problem first

• Communicates clearly and works well directly with non-technical stakeholders across teams

Nice to have, though not required: experience with Tableau or similar BI tools, billing or financial data, data modelling, workflow orchestration tools, exposure to LLMs/agents or MCP, or a general understanding of how SaaS businesses run (subscriptions, revenue metrics, GTM tooling, and the cross-team workflows common at software companies).

****Applying

****Your application doesn't need to be polished and you don't need to check all the boxes, to apply.

Tell us what you built, what you were trying to move, and what happened.

****Life at Onomondo

****The things we build have global reach. The way we build them is personal. We're a team of engineers, operators, and commercial minds in Copenhagen who debate passionately about technical or GTM approaches and then go for a run together. Or padel. Or a beer. Or a boardgame night. People here stay curious, speak up when something feels off, and bring energy whether it's a product launch sprint or a Friday bar.

Practically speaking, that looks like: paid health insurance, catered cooked-on-site lunch every day, an in-office gym with workouts (HIIT of yoga) three times a week during work hours (we're serious about this), quarterly Friday bars, an espresso machine, a full snack and drink-bar and a pretty impressive breakfast setup.

****Our hiring process

****We care deeply about creating a fair and inclusive process.

**That means:

**

• We don’t need your picture

• We select candidates based on skills and relevant work experience for the role.

**What you can expect:

**

• Screening call with Madalina, our Head of People (Online, 30 minutes)

• Skill interview with Jonathan & Mateusz, our Data Analytics Manager & Head of Revenue Operations (In-Person, 1 hour)

• Meet with our Co-Founder, Michael (In-Person, 30 minutes)

Note - We review and interview candidates continually, and therefore encourage you to apply at your earliest convenience.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral position in breast cancer epidemiology / clinical epidemiology
jobs.description:
The Department of Clinical Epidemiology at Faculty of Health at Aarhus University invites applications for a position as postdoctoral research fellow in the field of Breast Cancer Epidemiology as per 15 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. This is a two-year position is fully funded by the Health Insurance Denmark.

The Department of Clinical Epidemiology is a research department at Aarhus University Hospital, within the Institute of Clinical Medicine at Aarhus University. Researchers in the department use advanced epidemiological methods to study the prognosis of patient populations. The department is engaged in a variety of activities regarding clinical epidemiological research, including cancer prognosis research. The department is involved in counselling health care professionals to improve the quality of health care and treatment. A large number of projects in the department are carried out in cooperation with Danish and international collaborators.

About the research project
The position entails research within clinical epidemiology, specifically within breast cancer and breast cancer survivorship. The successful candidate will join a project focusing on studies related to adherence to breast cancer treatment; side effects and complications of breast cancer and its treatment; and how these may influence quality of life, long-term survivorship, and early and late breast cancer recurrence. The project investigates the association of pharmacological, genetic and socioeconomic factors and adherence to cancer treatment; employing advanced epidemiological methods including emulated target trials, group-based trajectory modelling, mediation analyses, and Bayesian modelling approaches to investigate adherence to cancer treatment and recurrence. The research fellow will join a vibrant and dynamic multinational and multidisciplinary project team (the Predictors of Breast Cancer Recurrence – ProBeCaRe – project team) with established successful long-term research collaboration. 

The successful applicant will contribute to the development of the department through research of high international quality. They will work closely with colleagues, receiving supervision and guidance. Emphasis will be placed on the applicant’s interest in building bridges between clinical, epidemiological and biostatistical research.

The main tasks will consist of:

• Research in clinical epidemiology, specifically within breast cancer and breast cancer survivorship.
• Make applications as needed for access to Danish population-based and medical registries.
• Independently perform statistical analysis using programmes such as R, SAS, or equivalent.
• Collaborate within an active research group with national and international collaborators.
• Contribute to teaching at the Aarhus University and its collaborators, as necessary.
• Take part in grant writing and participate actively in research fundraising.
• Gain experience supervising students.
• Conduct independent research of high international quality, including publication.
• Write scientific articles and participate in international congresses.
• Perform other tasks within the Department of Clinical Epidemiology fields of interest. Please see our webpage at www.kea.au.dk.
Your competences
You have academic qualifications at PhD/DSc level preferably within one or more of the following areas: epidemiology, clinical epidemiology, cancer epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, and/or can document familiarity with epidemiological research at an international level. Research experience in cancer and pharmacologic research would be advantageous, but not essential. Research experience in epidemiologic methods, analysing and incorporating data from Danish registries, including data from the National Clinical Quality Cancer Databases (specifically data from the Danish Breast Cancer Group), the Health Services Register, and the National Patient Registry, would be useful, particularly data incorporating socioeconomic factors. Research experience in cancer survivorship, patient reported outcomes and national surveys would be a benefit as well. Evidence of the ability to secure competitive research grants would be advantageous. As a person, you are motivated, ambitious, take ownership and possess good communication and interpersonal skills. We expect you to be fluent in oral and written English, with good knowledge of Danish.

In order to be assessed as qualified for this position, you must meet these academic criteria.
